title: opening an assigned submitted request moves it to under review

steps: (await request.post('/__e2e/assigned-review')).status()

queue.getByRole('button', { name: /Assigned Review Forum/ }).click()

title: rejecting requires a reason and shows it to the organiser
purpose: Verify the named user journey through the real application routes.
preconditions: Fresh browser context, reset loopback memory fixture and fixed browser clock; production app build. No hosted Supabase.
steps: (await request.post('/__e2e/under-review')).status()
request.post('/__e2e/under-review')
page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Refresh', exact: true }).click()
page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Awaiting review' }) .getByRole('button', { name: /Decision Forum/ }).click()
page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reject', exact: true }).click()
page.getByLabel(/Reason/).fill('Clashes with the AGM on the same evening.')
page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Profile', exact: true }).click()
page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Logout', exact: true }).click()
page.request.get('/api/event-requests/52', { headers })
page.getByRole('button', { name: /Decision Forum/ }).click()
data: headers = await authHeaders(page)
detail = await page.request.get('/api/event-requests/52', { headers })
decided = (await detail.json()).request
expected: expect((await request.post('/__e2e/under-review')).status()).toBe(204)
expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('reason is required')
expect(page.getByText('under review')).toBeVisible()
expect(page.getByText('rejected')).toBeVisible()
expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open app', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
expect(decided.status).toBe('rejected')
expect(decided.decision_reason).toBe('Clashes with the AGM on the same evening.')
expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Why this request was rejected' })) .toContainText('Clashes with the AGM on the same evening.')
actual: Passed in the current 28-journey Chromium run.
execution_evidence: npm run test:e2e; isolated loopback storage and test-only Chromium; no hosted Supabase.
